protocol.operator: corrected damping sign, full mixed magnetic curl
protocol.preparation: independent hot starts psi=0,T=1.2; no current-history continuation

ranking.rank: best nonbaseline variant and bracket; confirm only if score exceeds baseline screen best
ranking.null_result: honest bounded null if no candidate exceeds baseline screen best

holdout_freeze.candidate: one candidate plus bracket frozen before fresh holdout

currents.description: five uniform currents across selected bracket plus one shoulder one grid step outside each side

confirmation_gates.ordered_history: two consecutive negative intervals with simultaneous bounds plus refinement before stationary-branch claim

conditional_midpoints.rule: Only if selected candidate drop confirms but only one negative ordered interval; exploratory refinement, not independent confirmation

scope_limits: No gamma/C_eff broadening or automatic optimization
No stationary-NDR claim from screen alone

local_source_hashes.note: normalized campaign hashes above are authoritative; local model checkout differs bytewise

classification: exploratory screening only; no stationarity claim
frame_correlation_note: frames within a trajectory are not independent replicates
